# laravelforge_server_php_cli_config (Data Source)

Fetches the php.ini CLI configuration for a given PHP version on a Laravel Forge server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `php_version` (Number) ID of the PHP version whose CLI config is fetched.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server.

### Read-Only

- `configuration` (String) php.ini CLI configuration as reported by Forge.
